name: Survivor Croatia
overview: A group of castaways is stranded in the wilderness with no support, forced to survive while navigating grueling physical trials and shifting social alliances that lead to strategic betrayals and eliminations until one final winner remains.

seasons.name: Odisejev Otok - Season 1
seasons.overview: Survivor: Odisejev Otok is the first season of the Croatian version of the Swedish show Expedition Robinson, or Survivor and it aired 2005. Having been influenced by the success of the Croatian version of Big Brother, channel HRT decided to launch a Croatian version of Survivor which aired from May 12, 2005 to July 7, 2005.

seasons.name: Kostarika - Season 2
seasons.overview:
Survivor: Costa Rica is the fourth season of the Serbian version of the Survivor television series, created by Vision Team production company and broadcast by Prva Srpska Televizija.

This is also the second season of the VIP format and the first season with contestants from Croatia.

In addition to Serbia, the show was broadcast in Croatia (RTL Televizija), Bosnia and Herzegovina (Televizija OBN), Macedonia (Sitel televizija) and Montenegro (PRO TV).

Featuring 18 contestants (9 men and 9 women), broadcast started on March 12, 2012.[2]

The show is hosted by Andrija Milošević and for the first time Marijana Batinić.

Island of Dropped was again in play (in second season the name was "Ghost Island"): voted out players would be sent to Island of Dropped and participate in duels, with the winner remaining there until either the next duel or until two specific points where players were brought back into the game.

seasons.name: Dominican Republic - Season 3
seasons.overview:
Season 3 of Survivor Croatia premiered on 14 March 2022.

Survivor: Dominican Republic is a joint Croatian and Serbian season of the international reality game show Survivor. It's the fifth season of the show's Serbian version and the third season of the Croatian version (counting the co-produced fourth season of the Serbian version). It premiered on 14 March 2022 on Nova BH in Bosnia and Herzegovina, Nova TV in Croatia, Nova M in Montenegro, and Nova S in Serbia.

The show is hosted by Mario Mlinarić for Nova TV & Nova BH, and Bojan Perić for Nova S and Nova M.

20 castaways; 9 from Croatia, 1 from Bosnia & Herzegovina, 8 from Serbia and 2 from Montenegro, were split into two tribes, with the Croats and Bosnian on one, and the Serbs and Montenegrins on the other. Their names were originally "Blue tribe" and "Red tribe".

seasons.name: Survivor 2023 - Season 4
seasons.overview:
Survivor 2023 is the fourth season of Survivor Croatia. Registrations for the season started during the end of the previous season. This is the second season in which candidates from outside Croatia could apply. The season of the series started on March 6, 2023 on the television channels Nova TV and Nova S.

All of the format changes introduced in Dominikanska Republika were carried over to this one, with a few small twists added throughout the game. After 64 days, Antonia Ivić and Nataša Kondić earned the titles of Croatian and Serbian Sole Survivor respectively, after defeating Denis Sviličić and Anja Andrejić in the final challenge. Nataša also became the first winner in the history of Survivor Hrvatska & Srbija to play a Perfect Game, as she received no votes during the game, then got every jury vote to advance to the final and won in the final challenge, as well as the first Serbian woman to win either franchise.

seasons.name: Survivor 2024 - Season 5
seasons.overview: Survivor 2024 is the fifth season of Survivor Croatia. Registrations for the season started during the end of the previous season. This is the third season in which candidates from outside Croatia could apply. The season of the series started on March 4, 2024 on the television channels Nova TV and Nova S.  All of the format changes introduced in previous two seasons were carried over to this one, with a few small twists added throughout the game.
